summary: Baytex Energy Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual shareholder meeting held May 7, 2026. All director nominees were elected, KPMG was appointed auditor, and a non-binding advisory say-on-pay resolution was approved. The filing is a routine disclosure of meeting outcomes with no special situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. It does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other transformative corporate action.
